faq_heading: Homes near Gabrielle-Roy: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Gabrielle-Roy catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Conseil scolaire francophone School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Gabrielle-Roy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Gabrielle-Roy, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Gabrielle-Roy sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 285 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,190,000, townhomes $670,000, condos $475,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Gabrielle-Roy?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Gabrielle-Roy the median was 33 days on the market, closing at 96.7% of the list price, with 11% of sales above the list price for the 285 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Gabrielle-Roy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are W E Kinvig Elementary (0.3 km north-east), St Bernadette (0.7 km south) and Martha Jane Norris Elementary (0.7 km south-west).

Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
